english.meaning: to like one thing better than another
english.note: Used as 鐘意 X 多啲, like X more.

exampleSentences.english: Oh, then that’s no good. I like mochi better.
exampleSentences.traditional: 哦，咦，噉唔好嚹。我鐘意食糯米糍多啲。
